rationale: This sentence reports another informant’s knowledge of the verb; it does not translate I+klabṯo hiwoli b̚mašruqo. Noše layto dmoǧaq qarʕi. The supplied MAC verse 49 ends its translation after the assertion that nobody can beat the speaker. Preserve the informant information as a note.
